remarks: Welcome to this bright and airy 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom end unit condo located in the coveted, gated Chesterfield community-where comfort, convenience, and lifestyle come together seamlessly. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and entertaining, this home features a spacious open-concept layout with a generously sized kitchen that flows effortlessly into the living and dining areas. High ceilings and abundant natural light create an inviting, expansive feel throughout. Upstairs, you'll find two well-appointed bedrooms, each with its private ensuite bathroom-ideal for creating a sense of personal retreat. A versatile loft area offers the flexibility to serve as a third sleping area, home office, or creative space, tailor it to suit your needs. The finished lower level adds even more usable square footage, perfect for a hobbyroom, home gym, gameroom, or media lounge. Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day on the private back deck, surrounded by mature trees and the tranquil sounds of nature. Additional features include a private garage, extra parking, and access to the community's in-ground pools and clubhouse-perfect for summer relaxation and year-round gatherings. Located just minutes from shopping, dining, and commuter routes, this home offers the ideal blend of privacy and accessibility.
